up: For all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL1613838, return the compound ChEMBL ID, the canonical SMILES, the standard activity type (e.g., IC50, Ki), the standard value, the standard units, and the standard relation. Include structures for every compound found.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.standard_relation FROM activities a JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613838'
